items.q: a baritone sax player later became a surgeon, Carl Nemenioti or something. These names will come later but I mean we played at the Sub Alpino Club and we each made fifteen dollars.

ctx.x: Do you remember what the first paying gig you ever had was?

Absolutely. I don’t remember the name of the group but it was — I wish I could remember the guy’s name — an accordion player playing stuff like “Al Di La” a drummer, and I remember these faces, it was a guitar player and myself, oh and a baritone sax player later became a surgeon, Carl Nemenioti or something. These names will come later but I mean we played at the Sub Alpino Club and we each made fifteen dollars. And we were playing things like “Al Di La,” “Westminster [sic] Cathedral,” I was just sort of…
know the forms or anything like that. Then we went out to a diner afterwards and spent all the money.
